question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Siddhartha, Bob gets The Trial, Claire gets Dracula, Dave gets Walden, Eve gets Beloved, Fred gets Dune, and Gertrude gets Hamlet.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Bob and Alice swap books. Then, Alice and Gertrude swap books. Then, Gertrude and Eve swap books. Then, Claire and Bob swap books. Then, Eve and Bob swap books. Then, Eve and Fred swap books. Finally, Eve and Gertrude swap books. At the end of the semester, Gertrude has
Options:
(A) Siddhartha
(B) The Trial
(C) Dracula
(D) Walden
(E) Beloved
(F) Dune
(G) Hamlet
solution:
Row order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude
Initial: Siddhartha | The Trial | Dracula | Walden | Beloved | Dune | Hamlet
1. Bob ↔ Alice: The Trial | Siddhartha | Dracula | Walden | Beloved | Dune | Hamlet
2. Alice ↔ Gertrude: Hamlet | Siddhartha | Dracula | Walden | Beloved | Dune | The Trial
3. Gertrude ↔ Eve: Hamlet | Siddhartha | Dracula | Walden | The Trial | Dune | Beloved
4. Claire ↔ Bob: Hamlet | Dracula | Siddhartha | Walden | The Trial | Dune | Beloved
5. Eve ↔ Bob: Hamlet | The Trial | Siddhartha | Walden | Dracula | Dune | Beloved
6. Eve ↔ Fred: Hamlet | The Trial | Siddhartha | Walden | Dune | Dracula | Beloved
7. Eve ↔ Gertrude: Hamlet | The Trial | Siddhartha | Walden | Beloved | Dracula | Dune
Gertrude has Dune, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
